title: Vaccines and autism
text: Extensive studies involving millions of children have found no link between the MMR vaccine and autism. The 1998 paper that suggested a link was retracted after it was found to be fraudulent.

title: Measles vaccine safety
text: The measles, mumps and rubella vaccine is safe and effective. Two doses are about 97 percent effective at preventing measles. Side effects are usually mild, such as a sore arm or fever.

title: Autism causes
text: The exact cause of autism is not known. It often runs in families and is linked to genetic differences. Autism is not caused by vaccines, diet or parenting.

title: Lemon water does not cure cancer
text: Claims circulating on social media that drinking hot lemon water kills cancer cells are false. Oncologists say no food or drink cures cancer, and the claim has been debunked repeatedly.

title: Diet and cancer treatment
text: No specific diet has been shown to cure cancer. Patients should discuss nutrition with their care team, as some supplements can interfere with chemotherapy.

title: 5G and coronavirus
text: There is no evidence that 5G mobile networks spread the coronavirus. Viruses cannot travel on radio waves, and Covid-19 spread in many countries that have no 5G network.

title: Radio frequency exposure from 5G
text: Measurements of electromagnetic emissions near 5G base stations found levels far below the international safety guidelines set by ICNIRP.

title: RBI never asks for OTP
text: The Reserve Bank of India does not hold accounts for individuals and never asks customers to share their OTP, PIN or card details by phone, SMS or email.

title: Digital payment fraud awareness
text: Fraudsters pose as bank officials and ask for KYC updates through links. Customers should update KYC only at their branch or through the bank's official app.

title: Fact check: free laptops scheme
text: A message claiming the government is giving free laptops to all students under a new scheme is fake. No such scheme has been announced by the Ministry of Education.

title: Fact check: Rs 2000 notes
text: Rs 2000 banknotes were withdrawn from circulation in 2023 but remain legal tender. They can be exchanged or deposited at bank branches and RBI regional offices.

title: Chandrayaan-3 landing
text: Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander touched down near the lunar south pole on 23 August 2023, making India the first country to land near the south pole of the Moon.

title: Apollo 11
text: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the lunar surface while Michael Collins remained in orbit.

title: Moon landing hoax claims
text: Claims that the 1969 Moon landing was staged in a studio are false. Retroreflectors left on the Moon are still used by observatories, and independent missions have photographed the landing sites.

title: Drinking water and dehydration
text: Adults generally need about two to three litres of fluid a day, including water from food. Needs rise in hot weather and during exercise.

title: Great Wall visibility from space
text: The Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon, and it is very hard to see from low Earth orbit because it is narrow and similar in colour to its surroundings.

title: Great Wall of China
text: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications built over many centuries. Its total length, including all branches, is estimated at about 21,000 kilometres.

title: Brain usage myth
text: The idea that humans use only ten percent of their brains is a myth. Brain imaging shows activity throughout the brain, even during sleep.

title: Antibiotics and viruses
text: Antibiotics do not work against viruses such as those that cause colds and flu. Using them when not needed contributes to antibiotic resistance.

title: Monsoon onset over Kerala
text: The southwest monsoon normally sets in over Kerala around the first of June, with a standard deviation of about seven days.

title: Guaranteed returns warning
text: SEBI cautions investors against entities promising guaranteed or assured returns on stock market investments. No registered intermediary can guarantee returns.

title: Aadhaar update
text: UIDAI never asks residents to share their Aadhaar OTP over phone calls. Updates to demographic details can be made online through the myAadhaar portal.

title: EVM tampering claims
text: The Election Commission states that electronic voting machines are standalone devices with no wireless connectivity and cannot be hacked remotely.

title: Plastic rice rumour
text: Food safety authorities tested rice samples after viral videos claimed plastic rice was being sold, and found no plastic in any sample.

title: Bermuda Triangle
text: Insurers do not charge higher premiums for ships crossing the Bermuda Triangle, and studies show no more disappearances there than in other busy ocean areas.
